ORS packets distributed. 2 food samples, 1 water sample, 1 stool sample and 1 vomitus sample were collected; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from CHC Khatoli. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Bore well leakage and contaminated water pits were observed. Community used bore well water for drinking purposes. 10 blood samples collected and sent to MBS (Central Lab) were positive for Hepatitis E (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Chlorination of water sources done. Borewell was repaired and chlorinated; water supply was restored. Health education given regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from various villages of SC Sarkebasti Baluhandar, BPHC Lanka. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house fever survey done and a total of 9 positive malaria cases were identified. A total of 10054 blood slides have been examined since Jan 2019 out of which only 9 have turned positive. 7 were positive for P Falciparum and 1 each for P Vivax and mixed infection. All cases have been provided with antimalarial treatment. VBD camps were organized in the area. A total of 5200 ITBN were provided to the people.

Cases reported from Village Sisai NP Ward No-5, PHC Barauli, Block Barauli. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash. Both males and females were equally affected. Children and young adults were predominantly affected. Cases belonged to low socio economic status. All cases treated and advised isolation.

Cases reported from Village/SC Sareya Narendra, PHC/Block Barauli District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash. Both males and females were equally affected. Children and young adults were predominantly affected. Cases belonged to low socio economic status. All cases treated and advised isolation.

Cases reported from Village Basantpur, HSC Raipur Mahadeo, PHC-Saraiya, Muzaffarpur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases presented with red eyes, maculo papular eruption on body. Majority of them belonged to low socio-economic condition with poor sanitary conditions. MOICs & RRT Medical Team visited affected area. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Chaube, PHC/Block Sirdala. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases had history of consumption of food in a gathering and children were mainly affected, most affected age group was 3-12yrs. The suspected cause of the outbreak was lack of proper hygiene in food handling. Hygiene & sanitation related awareness given. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/SC Panchayat Sarsar, APHC Amlori, Block Sadar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash and conjunctivitis. All cases treated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Kutelamuda, SHC Rajkamma, PHC Chaitma, Block Pali. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony after which they developed vomiting and diarrhea. All cases treated. Chlorine tablets were distributed in affected area. Purification of water done by health team and health education regarding hand washing given by RRT.

Cases reported from Village Hatti, PHC/CHC Kagathur, Taluk Channagiri. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 3 Stool samples, 4 water samples and 1 vomitus sample sent to DPHL Davangere, result awaited. 06 food samples sent to PHI Lab, result awaited. Health camp organized in the school and all cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Nayathode, PHC/Block Angamal. Cases had history of consumption of beef which was the possible source of infection. 2 water sample collected from the well and sent to RPH Lab Ernakulam, result awaited. All cases treated. A 30 years old male expired of the illness. Health education given.

Cases reported from UHC PP Unit Kadakkal, PHC Nilamel, Block Nilamel. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. No food samples availed. Cases occurred after attending marriage ceremony at Sreesailam Auditorium and presented with vomiting, mild fever and diarrhea. Detailed food history was taken and it was observed that cases who consumed milk developed illness. No food samples were collected. Health education given.
Cases reported from Village Shrigonda, SC Erondoli, PHC / Block Sonwane Wasti.

Cases reported from Village Paraswadi, SC Dudhmala, PHC Godalwahi, Block Dhanora. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases had history of attending a marriage ceremony. All of them presented with vomiting, abdominal pain and loose motions. All cases treated symptomatically. RRT visited the affected area. Control room was established in the area. Water samples were taken, result awaited. Drinking water sources were chlorinated.

Case reported from Village Konashi, SC Asniye, PHC Talkat, Block Dodamarg. 4 blood samples from suspected persons were taken and all found negative for Malaria at PHC Talkat and 1 sample found positive for KFD at GMC Goa. Rapid survey done. Larvicides were used. Health education given. A 60 year old male died of illness.

Cases reported from Village/SC Walasa, PHC Saikheda, Block Darawha. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases occurred after consumption of food in “Tervi” held in village. Cases complained of vomiting, dysentery and pain abdomen. Patient admitted to nearest SDH Darawha and given treatment. 5 food sample taken, result awaited. Chlorination of common water source done. Cleanliness activity done in the village. Health education given.

Case reported from Village Gondan, SC Gondan, Block Bhander. Case presented with cough, Paroxymal coughing and posttussive vomiting. Nasopharyngeal swab and serum sample was collected and sent to Shivpuri Lab for culture, result awaited. Isolation was advised. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Karhi, Block Maheshwar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases had history of consuming food in a marriage ceremony. Food history revealed that cases who consumed rasmalai developed symptoms. Symptoms consisted of pain in abdomen and loose motions 2- hours after consumption of food. 1 food sample, 5 stool samples collected and sent to Department of MGM Medical college, result awaited. 2 water samples collected and sent to PHE Department, result awaited. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases treated.
Cases reported from Village Ganji, PHC Behrampur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases isolated and treated. Health education given.

Case reported from Village Thakkari, Block Phagwara. The case is a 5 year old child and belonged to a migratory settlement. Blood sample collected and sent to PGI, Chandigarh. Case was isolated and treated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/HSC Thenkeeranur, PHC Malaikottalam, Block Kallakurichi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 3 water samples sent to DPHL Kallakurichi and 2 found non potable. All cases treated symptomatically. Overhead water tanks cleaned and chlorinated. Disinfection done in households.

Cases reported from Village/PHC Kalikapur Under Bungung. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases had attended a family function after which they fell ill. They developed fever, vomiting and loose motions. All of them were taken to PHC for treatment. A 10 year old child died of the illness. Health camp organized in the area.

Cases reported from Village Godwa, SC Rahim Nagar Padiyana, PHC Harauni, CHC Sarojninagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash. Age Distribution 13-24 yrs. 6 Blood Samples sent to Virology Lab, KGMU, Lucknow. All cases treated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village -Sauria, Kamargoria, G.P-Jhamtia, Block Amta. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases had history of consumption of taking Prasad in "Mahaprobhvu utsav". 2 Food Samples and 2 vomitus samples collected and sent to CCL Kolkata and SSKM respectively, result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from a jail in Chitradurga Urban, PHC/CHC Buddanagara UPHC, Taluk Chitradurga. District RRT investigated the outbreak and visited the jail and examined jail inmates. 3 Blood samples, 47 Blood smears collected and sent to DPHL Chitradurga, all found negative for Dengue, Chikungunya and Typhoid. Jail authorities were asked to undertake vector control activities. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Ambalappuzha, HSC Komana, PHC/Block Ambalappuzha. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases occurred after consuming food in a house warming celebration. Cases presented with vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhea. All cases treated. Chlorination of well done. Health education given regarding food hygiene and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Changamoola Nayka colony in Village Poothadi, HSC Kenichira, PHC Poothadi, Block Sulthan bathery. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 11 Blood samples taken and sent to MCVR lab out of which - 6 samples tested positive for Scrub Typhus by Ig M ELISA. No history of tick bites could be elicited. The affected area was surrounded by dense forests. All cases treated symptomatically and Doxycycline prophylaxis given to contacts. Health education given. A 28 year old female died of the illness.

Cases reported from Village Mathpara, Ward-8, Rampurhat Municipality. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 3 rectal swab samples have been sent to Burdwan Medical College on 30.04.2019 and no pathogenic organism could be isolated in all 3 samples. All cases hospitalized at Rampurhat Govt. Medical College & Hospital. Alternative Water supply provided by water tanker by Municipal authority. Blocking regular pipeline water supply done by PHE. Necessary repair & action on pipeline will be done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/SC Naharpara Borbill, PHC/Block Naharani. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Water samples from tube well were collected and sent to Microbiology Dept, AMCH, Dibrugarh; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Halogen tablets and ORS packets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Longboi Tea Estate, SC Rajgarh, PHC/Block Naharani. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. Cases consumed food (wild mushroom) and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. Symptomatic treatment given to all cases. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village/SC Dabohibil & Nogakata Gaon & Nogakata Grant, BPHC, Japisajia, Block Sapekhati. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All the cases consumed food (wild mushroom) and presented symptoms with loose motion and vomiting. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Lakari Banbir, SC Lakari, PHC Phulwariya, Block Phulwariya. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Affected children were in the age group between 14 - 40yrs. 05 blood samples collected and sent to PMCH Patna; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/SC Khirasara, PHC Balagam, Block Keshod. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. Food samples collected; result awaited. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Villages Tinghara, Birna, Kashijore, Jamua, SC Rajon amrakunda, CHC Jarmundi Dumka Block Tinghara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 2 blood samples were collected and send to RIMS Ranchi; 1 sample was positive for chickenpox (IgM ELISA). Symptomatically treatment was given all cases. Health education given.

Cases reported from Hampi University Girls Hostel, PHC/CHC Kamalapura, Taluk Hospet. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in dinner and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. Food samples were collected and sent to Divisional food lab; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Kumbaluru, PHC/CHC Malebennuru, Taluk Harihara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in dinner and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 3 water samples collected; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Pullorkunnu, PHC Moopainad, Block Kalpetta. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the cases were labourers from Assam working in a tea estate. Cases presented symptoms of diarrhea and were admitted in District Hospital. 4 stool samples were collected and sent to WIMS & MCVR; were positive for cholera culture. All cases treated symptomatically. Chlorination of water sources done. Disinfection of the surrounding area done by bleaching powder. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

A 15yr old boy resident of Kallai area of Kozhikode Corporation presented symptoms of fever, neck stiffness and meningitis was admitted in MCH Kozhikode on 1st May 2019. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to House survey done. Blood and CSF sample were collected and sent to ICMR Alapuzha were positive for West Nile (IgM ELISA). Entomological survey done (HI 13.9; CI 12.3; BI 15.9). IRS and anti-larval measures were carried out in the affected area. Case discharged on 9th May 2019. Health education given regarding personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Village Bhawar and Laktu, PHC Sadrawadi, Block Dharni. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Saattalai PHC kroli Block Manwar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. All cases treated symptomatically. Food samples were collected and sent to FSO, Bhopal; result awaited. Stool samples collected an sent to MGM, Indore; result awaited. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Kherona, SC Budi Badod, CHC Satanwada, Block Satanwada. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in dinner and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from SC Tynhiang, CHC Riangdo, Block Mawshynrut. District RRT investigated the outbreak. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food (mushroom) in dinner and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Durbhata (Khairapada) under Biswanathpur CHC, Kalahandi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 03 water samples collected and sent to DPHL Kalahandi; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically ORS packets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Salepali, PO Salepali, SC Jarasingha, PS Tusura, CHC/Block Deogaon. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 01 water sample collected and sent to DPHL Balangir showed no growth of enteropathogens. All cases treated symptomatically ORS packets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Madanhery PHC Gharuan. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 9 blood samples collected and sent to DPHL SAS Nagar; result awited. 5 water samples were collected; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene, Hand hygiene practices and safe drinking water.
Cases reported from Village Hussainiwala & Chak Bare Ke, Block Mamdot. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/SC G.K Puran, PHC Meensuriti, Block Jayankondam. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in a social ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 2 water and 2 food samples were collected; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Sembarankulam, HSC Vedakavunji, PHC Perumpallam, Block Kodaikana. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 09 stool sample collected were negative for enteropathogens. 02 water sample collected and sent to DPHL Dindigul were non potable. All cases treated symptomatically ORS packets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Kolamguda, SC Kothapally, Mdl. Narnoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All the cases consumed food in dinner and presented symptoms with loose motion and vomiting. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village/SC Rampur, CHC/Block Jawan. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All the cases consumed food in dinner (chola and rice) and presented symptoms with loose motion and vomiting. One death occurred in a 5yr old male child. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Borokanaigachi, SC Raghunathnagar, GP Moshat, Block Diamond Harbour I. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. Cases consumed food (iftar party) and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 04 stool samples were collected and sent to SSKM Kolkata; result awaited. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Dhanirtori, Dineswari, Hatidhura SC Bararangrash GP, Cooch Behar-II. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. Cases consumed food (prasad) in a religious ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 03 stool samples and 1 food sample were collected and sent to NBMCH; result awaited. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever, cough and maculopapular rash reported from Village Yerraguntapalli, SC Ravi Venkatampalli, PHC Chukkalur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 2 blood samples collected and sent to IPM, Hyderabad; results awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin A supplementation provided. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Chhowkham Town, CHC Chhowkham. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 18 blood samples collected sent to CHC Chowkham; 15 blood samples were positive for widal test. 40 water samples collected were potable. Symptomatic treatment given to cases. Health education given regarding safe drinking water and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Tuglakabad (Churiya Mohalla, Kumhaar Mohallah, Kangar Mohalla), PHC Kangar Nohallah, Block Churiya Mohallah. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All 43 blood samples were collected were positive for Typhi dot test (ELISA). 13 blood sample collected and sent to Pt Madan Mohan Malviya; result awaited. Water samples collected and sent to Delhi Jal Board showed presence of ammonia confirming sewage contamination and the samples were bacteriologically unsatisfactory. All cases treated symptomatically. Food safety officer instructed to collect water samples from the water supply and shops for testing. Chlorine tablets were distributed in the community. Health education given safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Lura, Birna, SC Ngaibang, PHC Saipung Block Saipung. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases were children less than 5yr of age. Symptomatic treatment was given all cases. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Rayapudi, Mandal Thulluru. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases had history of consumption of food consisting of fish, chicken and liquor after which they developed Diarrhea and admitted at NRI General Hospital. 3 stool samples collected at NRI Hospital and tested Negative. 2 water samples collected and sent to regional lab for biological & chemical analysis and found negative. One stool sample sent to Guntur Medical college, result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given. Protection from heat wave also advised and a big tent with jumbo air coolers also installed at shelter for these workers. A 26 year old female and 70 year male died of illness.

Cases reported from Village Kotta Vedurupalli, PHC R.V.Nagar, Mandal Chintapalli. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 6 members of the same family collected mushrooms from the surrounding area and consumed it. No samples were collected. Villagers are educated to take only eatable mushrooms and to take fresh hot food. Para Medical Staff concerned have been instructed to continue door to door surveillance for one week. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Pothangi, PHC Dumbriguda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 1 water samples have been collected and send to the Regional Public Health Laboratory for analysis, result awaited. Water sources Chlorinated by the Panchayat. Health education given to take fresh, hot food and clean water and also to maintain environmental sanitation in the village. Para Medical Staff concerned have been instructed to continue door to door surveillance for 3 days. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village Seajuli Tiniali, MPHC Seajuli, BPHC Boginodi. All cases were from two families and had history of consuming mushrooms harvested from vicinity. After consumption they developed abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea. All of them admitted in Civil hospital and treated. 3 stool samples collected for culture and sensitivity test, Result awaited. RRT investigated the outbreak. Active Surveillance is going on by the health workers in the affected area. Awareness camp organized in the affected area.

Cases reported from Various villages of District Tinsukia. All had history of consuming mushrooms harvested from jungle. After consumption they developed abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea. All of them admitted in Tinsukia Civil hospital and further referred to Assam medical college and treated. RRT investigated the outbreak. Active Surveillance is going on by the health workers in the affected area. Awareness camp organized in the affected area

Cases reported from AT Vashudev Patti and Chakia Mohammadpur, HSC Saraiya, PHC/Block Saraiya. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Symptoms of red eyes, maculo popular eruption on body reported by cases. Majority of them belonged to low socio-economic condition, poor sanitary conditions found. MOICs & RRT Medical Team, visited affected area for investigating and taking control measures. All affected person and others sensitized about their personal hygiene and cleanliness. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village ToyBigha, HSC Kajifattuchak, PHC Barbigha, Block Barbigha. All patients are having fever with maculo popular rash. All patients given treatment & medicine under supervision of MOIC & Medical team. All affected were between 2 to 25 years of age. RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. IEC activity done regarding personal hygiene and isolation of cases. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village Tille Gowdana Doddi & Rasi Boli Thanda, PHC/CHC Sathegala, Taluk Kollegal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Index case had history of travel to Gundal, Duganikote Tq, Dharmapuri District, Tamilnadu one week prior to development of symptoms. He developed fever and joint pain and within one week other people of village developed same symptoms. 5 blood samples tested negative for Dengue and Chikungunya, 15 blood smears tested negative for Malaria.

Cases reported from Village Aurundi, PHC/CHC Nyamathi CHC, Taluk Honnali. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases attended a ceremony. 05-water sample tested by H2S method at DSU and 02 found unfit. 01 stool sample collected and found negative for any enteropathogen. All cases treated. Health education given. Active surveillance is continuing in the area.

Cases reported from Village Koradkera, PHC/CHC Chalgera, Taluk Kustagi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Leakages in water pipeline have been observed causing mixing of drinking water with sewage. Leakages have been repaired and chlorination done. Alternate water supply provided. 3 stool samples tested negative for Salmonella, Cholera and Shigella and 4 water samples sent to DPHL Lab found potable. Health education given.

Und er Surveillance Cases reported from Village Alkola, PHC/CHC Seegihatti, Taluk Shimoga. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Well-Water contamination was suspected for the Outbreak. Government well is a common source of drinking water, through which water is supplied to households through pipelines. Well water contamination has been suspected as the cause of outbreak. 36 blood samples and 4 water samples were collected and sent to DSU lab. 20 blood samples tested positive for Hepatitis E by Ig M ELISA and 3 out of 4 water samples tested unfit for drinking. Well has been chlorinated and all cases treated at health facility.

Cases reported from Village Manjapra, PHC/Block Angamaly. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony. Possible source of infection was pasta salad as per case history. All cases had abdominal pain, vomiting and loose stools. 2 water samples collected and sent to RPH lab Ernakulam, result awaited.

Cases reported from Village Div12, HSC Thevally, PHC Thrikkadavoor, Block Kollam Corporation. All cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony. Food handlers were examined and none of them had health card. Kitchen premises were unhygienic and water used for cooking was also unchlorinated. Cases had abdominal pain, loose motions and vomiting. 2 water samples taken and sent to PH lab Kollam for culture and found satisfactory. All cases treated. Water chlorinated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/HSC Chendayad, PHC Kunnothuparamba, Block Panoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 2 Blood samples collected and tested at RPH Lab Kannur and found positive for Hepatitis A. Water sample from the wells used for cooking purpose in the function collected and sent to quality analysis. Cases had history of consuming food in a marriage ceremony. Mass super chlorination done. Fever survey done.

Cases reported from Village Ponganad, HSC Nil, PHC/Block Kilimanoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. It was observed that around 50 children were being given swimming training in village pond by some private agency. All 03 affected had history of going to this pond. They developed fever and body ache. 3 blood samples taken and all found positive for Leptospirosis by Ig M ELISA. Panchayat was alerted and people asked not to take a dip in the pond. Pond cleaning started.

Cases reported from Village Jaiaw, Shillong. Four males and four females were affected with age group ranging from 20 to 60 years. The common symptoms were multiple episodes of diarrhea and vomiting, nausea, chills and abdominal pain. Two stool samples collected and sent to ICMR Dibrugarh, result awaited. No food sample was available for collection. Investigated by RRT. The cases were admitted to a private hospital in Shillong and provided symptomatic treatment and at present are responding well to the treatment.

Cases reported from Boys Government Residential Hostel Nimbhora under Amravati Muncipal Corporation. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Pipe-lines and Valve leakages, irregular chlorination, Junk food and bad dietary habits, all these factors caused Viral Hepatitis A. 1 water sample collected and sent to DPHL Amravati. Result – Awaited. Active case search done. Super- chlorination of main water source (Bore-well) done. Alternate water supply started. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village/CHC/Block Segaon. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Leakeages were observed in water pipelines supplying water to households. 4 stool samples were collected and sent to department of microbiology MGM medical college Indore, result is awaited. 5 water samples collected by PHE department, result are awaited. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house health survey done, chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed. Medical camp organized and all cases treated symptomatically. Health education given among community.

Cases reported from Village Shanpur, PO/SC Sikachhida, CHC/Block Chudapali. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Some cases found with stomach ache with loose motion after consumption of Raw mango fruit in a field and those people were professionally kendu leaf worker. 05 Nos of water samples sent to DPHL, Balangir and 3 found unfit for drinking. ORS distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bariapali, GP Seriguma, SC Deulabadi, CHC/Block K. Singpur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All patients were labourers and staying at a camp near Bariapali village. All had history of consumption of poisonous wild Mushroom collected from the nearby Jungle. They developed hematemesis and unconsciousness. All patients were immediately shifted to DHH Rayagada for treatment. Affected cases are treated at DHH Rayagada HW (M) &HW (F) is in search of new cases. MO I/C CHC K. Singpur is advised to keep the village under surveillance for 2 weeks from the date of reporting of last case. MHU K.Singpur deployed for 7 days to the village for case management & MAT. IEC activity regarding safe water and food items. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Urban Pratapgarh. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 Suspected Patient Found with Fever & maculopapular Rashes with Cough & Coryza in Scatted Population in Urban Area of Pratapgarh. 5 Serum Sample sent to Microbiology Lab. SMS Medical College Jaipur for Confirmation of Measles & Rubella by ELISA, result awaited. DRRT Visited Affected Area. House to House surveillance is ongoing. All cases treated under isolation.

Cases reported from 2 RKM, Kundal Village Gharsana. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected case had history of consumption of raw milk from a cow he owned. His blood sample was tested positive at Bikaner Medical College Four blood samples from house member taken and sent to Bikaner Medical College, result awaited. 10 blood samples from cattle were also taken and sent to animal husbandry department. RRT visited the area. Patient was treated and discharged asymptomatic. House to house survey done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/SC Gattunellikuduru, PHC Pedduru. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 2 Stool samples collected and sent to Dist. Public Health Lab (IDSP), Mahabubnagar for bacteriological investigations and 5 water samples collected and sent to RWS Lab Nagarkurnool for bacteriological investigations, result awaited. Health Education given to people on personal Hygiene and maintain the sanitation in and around the kitchen. Did the Pot Chlorination in the Village.

Cases reported from Village Murtaza Nagar, Post kheuli, SC Mittai, CHC/Block Dewa. Cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony. RRT investigated the outbreak. It was observed that left over food was eaten in morning also. 1 food sample taken, result awaited. All cases were treated.
Cases reported from Village Abdullaganj, CHC Ujhani, Block Ujhani. Cases presented with fever with rash. RRT visited the area. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Howrah, WARD Panchla, GP Jujasha, Municipalty/Block Malipukur Samaj Unnayan Samiti. It was observed that inmates were living in very poor sanitary conditions. The kitchen were food was prepared was also dirty without proper water and food storage facilities. 4 water samples collected and sent to public health lab Kolkatta. 07 rectal swabs were taken and sent to SSKM Kolkatta, out of which 4 had pathogenic E Coli and 01 had V Cholera. Control measures were undertaken. All cases treated.

Cases reported from Village Bishaipara, S/CHarendranagar & Ramgopalpur, GP Ramgopalpur, Block Kakdwip. District RRT investigated the outbreak. People were affected after eating Sinni (Suji+Raw milk Fruits), Puri, Chana Daal, Fruits on the occasion of Satya Narayan Puja in the evening of 18/05/2019. One (1) stool sample collected on 19.05.2019 (5 PM) and sent to SSKM, Kolkata on 20.05.2019. Result awaited. Block RRT visited the affected area. Active search done. Medicine distributed & IV fluids & ORS given. IEC done & Health education imparted. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Gogal Salcete, UHC Margao. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 15 blood samples tested positive for NS1 and 2 cases positive by IgM Mac Elisa for Dengue. All cases treated symptomatically. Mosquito breeding was found in overhead tanks. Fever survey done. Overhead tanks were checked and cleaned. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Oachghat, Bajhol, SC Jatoli, PHC Sultanpur, Block Dharampur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Patients had fever and yellowish skin discoloration. 2 water samples were sent to Pune virology lab for viral testing and also for coliform count. Water supply was chlorinated.

Cases reported from Village Maruthomkara, HSC Pashukadavu, PHC Maruthomkara, Block Kunnumal. The area had lot of water collections in rubber estates, coco planters, arecanut trees. Intersectoral meeting was done to take control measures. Source reduction activities done. Fogging done. Indoor residual spray done. Miking done in the area to spread awareness. 3 blood samples tested positive for Dengue by Ig M ELISA at. 17 blood samples tested positive for NS1 Antigen.

Cases reported from Chappappadi Area, Village Neduva, HSC Chappapadi, PHC/HSC/Block Neduva. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 01 Blood & CSF sample tested positive for Anti – WNV IgM antibody – ELISA Positive at ICMR Alappuzha. Culex mosquito breeding was found abundantly. RRT team visited area. Vector study done. Area under observation. No other similar cases were found in the area. Vector control measures initiated in the area.

Cases reported from various villages and SCs of CHC Bijhari, Block Barsar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Majority of cases are seen in age group of 11 -20 years of age and have history of attending educational institutions. 9 Blood samples have been taken and tested at LBSMC Ner Chowk Mandi and all found positive for Hepatitis A. All cases treated symptomatically. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bochakata, SC Bhurakata, BPHC Gazarikandi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Paddy fields and water loggings seen in the affected areas. Active search of cases done. Out of 12 blood smear collected 02 blood samples were found positive for malaria parasite (PV) tested at Gazarikandi BPHC. All cases treated locally. Source reduction activities undertaken. Awareness camp regarding prevention and control of vector borne disease were carried out in the affected areas.

Cases reported from Village Mudpaar, PHC Mangchuwa, Block Dondilohara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in a social ceremony. Water samples collected: result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and zinc tablets were distributed in the community. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Kaundkera, SC Sorid, PHC Garhsiwani, Block Tumgaon. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Water samples were collected and sent to Microbiology Dept, Pt JNM College, Raipur; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets were distributed in the community. Chlorination of water sources done. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from Village/SC Vadad, PHC Vanghroli, Block Galteshwar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 03 stool samples collected and sent to DPHL Nadiad; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and chlorine tablets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

A suspected case of CCHF was admitted at Sir Takhtsingh General Hospital reported from Village/SC Ningala, PHC Khopala, Block Gadhada. The case presented symptoms of fever with rigor, body ache and headache since 08th May 2019. Serum samples collected and tested at NIV, Pune was positive for Crimean Congo Hemorrhagic Fever on 17th May 2019. The case expired on 18th May 2019. District RRT visited & investigated outbreak. Active search of cases done. Lime dusting done in village. IEC regarding CCHF done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bhagwanpur SC/PHC Kharwan, CHC Khizabad. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 4 water samples were collected and sent to DPHL Karnal; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and chlorine tablets were distributed in the community. Health education given regarding personal hygiene, Hand hygiene practices and safe drinking water.

Cases reported from Village Tisri, Block Gomia. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out 06 blood samples collected sent to RIMS Ranchi; 05 blood samples were positive for Chickenpox. Symptomatic treatment was given all cases. Health education given.

Cases reported from Noorani Public School, Village Arigam, Block Khanshab. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from urban Ward No-10, 12 & 13, PHC/CHC Yaraguppi, Taluk Kundagol. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 08 stool samples collected and sent to KIMS Referral Lab, Hubballi; result awaited. Out of 04 water samples sent to DSU Lab; 4 samples are not potable. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Annapura-A, PHC/CHC Hothanakatte, Taluk Shikaripura. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in a social ceremony. 02 stool and 05 water samples collected and sent to SIMS Microbiology Department, Shimoga for culture & sensitivity; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and halogen tablets were distributed in the community. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Nidagallu, PHC/CHC Mangalawada, Taluk Pavagada. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in a religious ceremony. Out of 04 water samples collected; 3 samples were non-potable. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and halogen tablets were distributed in the community. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Mallenahalli Tanda Bevinahalli, PHC/CHC Kuppur, Taluk CN Halli. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in a religious ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 3 stool samples and 2 water samples collected were negative for enteropathogens and water samples were non potable. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Mundakai Valappu, SC Pouval, PHC/CHC Muliyar, Block Muliyar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All 2 blood samples collected and sent GH Kasargod were positive for Hepatitis A (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Chlorination of water sources done. Health education given.

A 9yr and 10month old fully immunized boy presented symptoms fever sore throat vomiting and headache was admitted in Sri Avittom Thirunal Hospital on 22nd May 2019. Throat swabs collected and seen to Govt. Medical College & Hospital, Trivandrum was positive for C.diphtheria. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 64 close contacts were given Erythromycin chemoprophylaxis. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Chengaroth, HSC Kalloor, PHC Chengaroth, Block TH Perambra. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All the cases consumed mango juice which was prepared from well water. All 2 blood samples collected and sent GH Kasargod were positive for Hepatitis A (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Chlorination of water sources done. Health education given.
Cases reported from Village Chadeibas (Das Sahi), SC Bisuniapada, CHC Balakati, Block Balianta. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Hadia, CHC Rabanaguda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 2 rectal swabs and 2 water samples (tube well) were collected; result awaited. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Tulispur, Budpasi, SC Palsama, CHC Chatabar, Block Reamai. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food (suji bhoga) in social ceremony (Trinath Mela) and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Senior Secondary School, Baba Deep Singh Nagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. 6 blood samples were collected & sent to DPHL, Ludhiana; results awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.
Cases reported from Village Bhallian, Tehsil Chamkaur Sahib. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Makkowal, Tehsil Chamkaur Sahib. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. 08 blood samples collected and sent to DPHL Rupnagar; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Rajpurbagha, Siswania Tola. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. Age wise distribution of cases Age group No of cases 0-5yrs 7 5-10yrs 11 10-15yrs 11 >15yrs 15 All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from S.M.M Home Liluah, Howrah Municipal Corporation, Howrah. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food (sarbat) and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 3 rectal swabs collected and sent to SSKM were negative for enteropathogens. 4 water samples (tube well) were collected; result awaited. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Raytala, SC Ramkishorepur, GP Ramkishorepur, Block Kulpi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food in religious function (Iftar party) and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 2 rectal swabs and 1 vomitus samples were collected; result awaited. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases of high grade fever and severe joint pain reported from Village Ugamnabara, SC Vachlabara-2, PHC Vachlabara, Block Khambhaliya. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Out of 9 blood sample collected and sent to General Hospital Khambhaliya & GGH Hospital, Jamnagar; 5 samples were found positive Chikungunya (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Timmanahalli, PHC/CHC Kalasapura, Taluk Chikkamagaluru. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Since the affected area has scarcity of water; water storage practices observed in the community. Out of 4 blood sample collected; 1 samples were found positive Dengue (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Kunduthode, SC Pashukadavu, PHC Kunduthode, Block Kunnuma. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Affected area has rubber plantation, arecanut plantation and coconut plantation and large number of coconut shell and rubber leaves filled with rainwater scattered around the field. These shells and leaves are good breeding places of Aedes mosquitoes. Out of 5 blood samples collected 2 samples were found positive Dengue (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Case reported from Village Elijipra, SC Marancode, PHC/Block Elijipra. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The case belonged to a tribal community presented symptoms of fever, weight loss and hepatosplenomegaly. Bone marrow examination at Pathology lab, MCH Thrissur showed Leishmania donovani. Vector surveillance done. Medical camp organized. IRS and control measures done. Health education given.
Cases reported from Village Thangbuli, PHC Jarain, Block Amlarem. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Symptomatically treatment was given all cases. Health education given.

Cases reported from urban area of S.C. Colony Karamukkala, PHC Palthru, Vidapanakal Mandal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. Cases consumed food in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 1 stool sample collected and sent to VRD Lab, Dept. of Microbiology, GMC Ananthapur; sample showed growth of E.coli. Symptomatic treatment given to all cases. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Ghilghuri (2 & 3), Deogharia, SC Gowal Chapori, PHC Dhemaji. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Water samples from tube well were collected and sent to PHED Dhemaji were found potable for drinking. All cases treated symptomatically. ORS packets and zinc tablets were distributed in the community. IEC done regarding safe drinking water and personal hygiene.

Cases reported from PHC Kishanpur Phulkaha. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Affected children were less than 10yr age group. 05 blood samples collected and sent to PMCH Patna; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Mendarda, PHC Dedakiyali, Taluk Mendarda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All cases consumed food (milk product) in marriage ceremony and presented symptoms with vomiting and loose motion. 1 food sample collected; result awaited. ORS packets distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bhawanipur (Mukhiyatola), SC Bhawanipur, CHC Pakur Block Pakur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 5 blood samples collected and sent to RIMS Ranchi; 1 sample was positive for Measles (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin A supplementation provided. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.

Cases of loose motion and vomiting and pain abdomen reported from several blocks of District Doda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Water samples sent to PHE Dept; result awaited. ORS and zinc tablets were distributed in the blocks. A meeting was organized by District Development Commissioner regarding provision of safe drinking water to the community followed by water testing once in a month. Chlorine tablets distributed in the community. Chlorination of water sources done in the community. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding drinking boiled and cooled water for daily consumption.

Cases reported from Village Gujjarpa Malagam, SC Malagam NTPC Quil Maquam, Block Bandipora. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 11 blood samples collected and sent to DPHL Srinagar; 2 samples were positive for Hepatitis E (IgM ELISA). 3 water samples were collected and tested were found non potable. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene, Hand hygiene practices and consumption of safe drinking water.

Cases reported from Village Khilegaov, PHC/CHC Anathapur, Taluk Athani. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 5 blood sample collected and sent to BIMS; 2 samples were found positive Dengue (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases of fever with swelling of parotid glands reported from Village Gollaradoddi, PHC/CHC Lakshmipura, Taluk Ramanagara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the cases were in the the age group of 3-12yrs. Out of 7 serum samples collected and sent to BMC Bangalore; 5 samples were positive for Mumps (Ig M ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Isolation of cases and hygiene practices were imparted in the community.

Cases reported from Village Pipadhari, SC Satti, PHC Tembrusonda, Block Chikhaldara. House to house survey done. Affected children were less than 10yr of age. 03 blood samples collected; result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from SC Kamarli, PHC Kamarli, Taluka Pen. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 4 water samples were collected and sent to DPHL Pen; result awaited. Chlorination of water sources done. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Vidisha, SC Vidisha Urban, PHC Mohalla, Block Chopra. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. 6 blood samples collected and sent to Hamidia Hospital Lab, Bhopal; result awaited. Vitamin A supplementation provided to all cases. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

A 28yr old male resident of Chendong Sadle presented symptoms of severe headache, vomiting, fever and dizziness was admitted in District Hospital Tuensang on 24th May 2019. Blood samples were collected and tested for Typhoid (Widal), JE (Rapid test), Scrub typhus and Malaria; were negative for all the above test. Symptomatically treated the case. He was discharged on 28th May 2019. Health education given.

Cases reported from Maiyanuthampatty, Village Maiyanuthampatty, HSC Anaikaraipatty, PHC Saptur, Block Sedapatti. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Out of 5 serum samples collected and sent to DPHL Madurai; 4 samples were positive for Chikungunya (IgM ELISA), 2 samples were positive for Typhoid, 1 sample was positive for Dengue (IgM ELISA). All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Hardia, PHCBaghudi, Block Nawanagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of cases done. All the cases consumed stale food and presented symptoms with loose motion and vomiting. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Siyavani Khurd Block Mauranipur Jhansi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash. Affected children were in age group between 8 months to 29yrs. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

A 49yr old female case resident from Kottooly, UHC Ponomkode, Khozikode Corporation Area presented symptoms of fever, headache and vomiting on 4th May 2019 and was admitted in the hospital. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Migratory birds (crane) were observed in the affected area. Blood and CSF samples of the case was collected and sent to NIV, Allapuzha. The samples were found positive for West Nile virus (IgM ELISA). Entomological survey done. IRS and anti-larval measures were carried out in the affected area. Case cured and discharged. Health education given regarding personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Mar Ivanios Bethany Girls Hostel, Nalanchira Village Mannanthala, SC/PHC/Block Pangappara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases consumed food (pickle, potato curry, papad) in dinner and presented symptoms with loose motion, vomiting and abdominal pain. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

A 23 year old male residing at Vadakkekara, Paravur a student of Al Akbar College Thodupuzha, presented symptoms of fever with altered sensorium was referred to a private hospital at Eranakulam on 30th May 2019. Throat swab, CSF, blood and urine were collected and sent to NIV Pune; the samples were found positive for Nipah Virus (Real-time RT-PCR, nested RT-PCR and for anti-Nipah human IgM and IgG antibodies by ELISA assay). Presently the case is stable. Central team and State/District RRT investigated the outbreak. Control room was set up at State Headquarter (Trivandrum) and District Headquarter (Ernakulum). 330 contacts were traced and 13 suspected cases samples were found negative for Nipah. 141 bats were captured and samples were collected (rectal and throat swabs) were tested. Out of these one bat sample was found positive for Nipah viral RNA. Standard NIPAH outbreak guidelines were implemented in the hospital and community settings. Health education given.

Cases reported from PHC Chouldari. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All affected were males and labourers. All took meal from a dhaba after which they developed vomiting and dizziness. All of them treated at PHC. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Dimum Puring School, Palin Town, under CHC Palin. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All affected children were taken back by parents. No samples could be taken. Contaminated food and water were probable sources of infection. Health education given regarding safe drinking water and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Angkaling, under CHC Kalaktang, Block Kalaktang. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 3 blood samples collected and confirmed positive for Scrub Typhus by Immuno Chromatographic Assay Rapid Test at CHC Kalaktang. Cases reported with fever, chills, and headache. Typical eschar/lesion observed under arms. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Dhawadangal, HSC Phuljhinjri, CHC Kathikund Dumka. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the affected were using water from unprotected well. All belonged to poor socioeconomic status with poor sanitation. Medical camp was organized in the area. All cases were treated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Deewan bagh, PHC NTPHC Old Town, Block Sheeri. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 6 blood samples and 2 water samples collected, result awaited. Chlorine tablets distributed. Health education regarding use of boiled water, hand washing, proper cooking and handling of food given. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Shopian Shahi-hamdan school Batpora, Shopian. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases presented with fever and maculopapular rash. All cases were treated under isolation. Health education regarding the disease, its modes of transmission imparted among children as well as school Staff.

Cases reported from Village Mar Ivanios Bethany Girls Hostel –Nalanchira. MCH Unit Pangappara, Mannanthala (Corp). Students had Fried rice, Chicken curry, salad, Pickle, Potato curry, Papad for dinner and on next early morning developed abdominal pain, vomiting, loose stools. All the students were discharged after treatment by same evening. No other cases were reported later. Public Health Team from MCH-Unit Pangapara inspected the area. Health education given and suggestions were given to prevent future outbreak.

Cases reported from Village Ramji halli, PHC/CHC Bageshpura, Taluk Arasikere. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 blood samples for Dengue, 3 blood samples for Typhoid culture collected, result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Jodigubbi, PHC/CHC Keragod, Taluk H.N. Pura. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the affected attended a ceremony and had history of consuming chicken in the function after which they developed stomach pain. 2 water samples collected for H2S and found potable & 1 water sample collected for MPN, result awaited. 1 stool sample tested negative for Cholera. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bijapura colony, PHC/CHC Mallipatna, Taluk Arakalagud. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the affected attended a ceremony and had history of consuming chicken in the function after which they developed stomach pain. 3 water samples collected for H2S and found potable & 1 water sample collected for MPN, result awaited. 1 stool sample collected, result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Lakshmipur Wadi, PHC/CHC Ravoor, Taluk Chittapur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Investigation shows: The gastroenteritis cases occurred due to People consuming contaminated water from draw well situated near Yallamma temple. House to house survey done for active case search. Distribution of 25000 Halogen tablets. IEC activities and advice on drinking safe water given. Super chlorination of drinking water sources. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village /SC Tippanal, PHC/CHC Hire-Vankulkunta, Taluk Yalburga. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases were reported from children consuming mid-day meal consisting of Rice, Sambar, Egg and poyasa. All children admitted at District hospital. 3 water samples tested by H2S found potable. Active case search done. IEC on food safety and safe water drinking has been done. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village Navule Bsavapura, PHC/CHC Donabhaghatta, Taluk Bhadravathi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Water collections inside and outside of houses was noted with larval breeding. House to house fever survey done. Additional health team deployed for surveillance of fever cases. All cases treated. 14 blood samples collected and sent to DSU Shimoga for testing, all found positive for Chikungunya by IgM ELISA. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Makraguda, Mahaling SC, Chapuria, Kalahandi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Contaminated water supply was supposed to cause the jaundice. Serum Sample collected-6, Water Samples collected-5. Tube well premises were cleaned. Water chlorinated. Handwashing promoted. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Tetrabahal, SC Dullarpur, GP Andalijambahal, and CHC/Block Kuarmunda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Infection spread after handling & taken dead goat meat. House to house search continuing, IEC activities, Group meeting done, Contact Doses Given.

Cases reported from Partap Nagar BTI, Aggarwal Colony BTI, Krishan Colony Bti, VPO Gari Bhagi, Block Goniana, VPO Mehta Block Sangat, Qila Road Bti, VPO Jassi Pauwali Block Goniana, and VPO Bhagwangarh Block Sangat. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Fever with malaise, swelling tenderness present over parotid region. All blood samples tested were positive for Mumps by ELISA. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Banga town, District SBS Nagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Patients are reporting with symptoms of abdominal pain, loss of appetite, yellowish discoloration of skin and fatigue. 5-6 cases are from same school rest belong to different areas of the city. 15 blood samples collected out of which 13 tested positive for Hepatitis A by IgM ELISA at SPHL. 16 water samples collected out of which 15 found non potable at SPHL. Chlorine tablets distributed in school, IEC activity done, Patients being educated to take proper hygiene measures. Survey in the affected areas is in process.

Cases reported from Village Raipur Majri, PHC Sanghol. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 06 blood samples were collected out of which 04 were positive for Hepatitis E by IgM ELISA at DPHL Patiala. 05 water samples collected and all found nonpotable by H2S test. Advise for sanitation awareness given regarding the mode of transmission. All cases symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Barathinagar, Veerappanaickenpatti, HSC Veerappanaikanpatti, PHC Theerthamalai, Block Harur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 serum samples sent to IVCZ, Hosur, Krishnagiri for Dengue, result awaited. Due to scarcity and insufficient supply of water, public used to store water without proper cleanliness and waste is disposed in improper way. Break in pipeline is also identified. Pipeline repair, Source reduction, antilarval activities done. OHT chlorination done. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Hill Area, Village/HSC Patchalur, PHC Poolathur, Block Palani. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 serum samples sent to DPHL Dindigul, 2 positive for Leptospirosis. Water samples collected from well and overhead tank and sent to DPHL, result awaited. Chlorination work is monitored for all drinking water sources. Mass cleaning campaign conducted. All cases treated.

Cases reported from Village Chimanguda, SC Kondapur Mdl. Pittabongaram. District RRT investigated the outbreak. They had history of consuming rice and mutton in a ceremony, after which they developed symptoms of vomiting and loose motion. 1 rice sample tested was negative for any pathogen, 1 sample of mutton tested positive for Staphylococcus Aureus, 1water sample tested positive for E Coli. All cases treated. Medical camp organized. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Sangem, Saloora PHC, Bodhan Mandal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases had history of consumption of food in a ceremony. All had abdominal pain and loose stools. All ages were affected. Health education given in the village no further cases in the village. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Amanatpur Salreli and Bhudkuda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. All cases treated. Medicine, Chlorine, Bleaching Powder and ORS Distributed. Health education given. Samples of ice-cream taken from factory of that area and sent to Lab by FSDA. Health camp organized in the school and all cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village ll Mohalla Alampur (Nayi Basti), PHC Bhadohi, SC-CHC Bhadohi. Block Bhadohi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. IEC in the affected area done regarding personal hygiene, consumption of fresh food and clean drinking water. All cases treated at MBS hospital Bhadohi. Distribution of ORS, Chlorine tablets and bleaching powder done in the area. Health camp organized in the school and all cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Uttar Mamudpur and Boltala, G.P Hingalganj, Block Hingalganj, District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases reported from hamlets situated close to roads. Drinking water was provided by van. . Four stool samples collected and send to NICED, Beleghata for bacteriological test, result awaited. Active case finding done in the community. Essential medicines were given. PHE department was requested to provide chlorinated water. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Amchung Tea garden SC Ghogua SD Digaru BPHC Sonapur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases reported from the labourers of a tea estate. All of them were using water from a common stream. All of them were treated at PHC. 3 water samples from stream sent to DPHL, Sonapur for MPN & H2S test, fecal contamination found. 6 stool samples collected sent to DPHL, Sonapur, negative for Cholera. RRT visited the area, house to house survey done. Counseling regarding personal health and hygiene and safe drinking water was given. ORS and Zinc tablet was distributed among the community. Informed the PHE Dept. and requested to take necessary action.

Cases reported from Village Balipathar, SC-Thekaraguri under Ahatguri SHC of Jhargaon BPHC. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases were from same family. All of them presented with fever, cough and maculopapular rash. All were treated. House to house visit done to identify more cases. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Makhibaha, Village Milanpur, Village/SC Borajol, Village Kakaya. All affected were adults. All had fever, headache, body ache, gastrointestinal pain and chest pain. No eschar or change in mental status was observed. There was no travel history. No contact with cattle or pets. 4 blood samples collected and sent to DPHL, SMK Civil Hospital, Nalbari and all found positive. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Case reported from Village Soligram, SC Kalain, PHC Jalalpur. This case presented with history of fever and neurological symptoms. One CSF sample was taken and it tested positive for JE by IgM ELISA at SRL Lab SMCH. Fever surveillance done in the area. Fogging and other mosquito control measures were taken. The case died due to illness.

Cases reported from Yadav Nagar Kampthi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 blood samples collected and were positive for Dengue by NS1. All cases were treated symptomatically. Health education given.

On 26-01- 20 he took a taxi to the Bangalore airport, after having food in a restaurant at the airport, he traveled to Kochi. From the Kochi airport he traveled to Aluva railway station in a taxi; from there to Angamaly by train and then took an auto to reach a nearby hotel and stayed there. On 30-01-20 morning he developed running nose and reached District Hospital, Kanhangad on 31-01-20 morning by car and was admitted in isolation ward. Throat swab and blood samples were taken on 31-01-20 and sent to NIV, Pune. On 03-02-20 the sample was found positive for COVID-19 by RT-PCR. Cases treated symptomatically. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on food hygiene, safe drinking water and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Karsuma, Block Bahua District Fatehpur. Cases presented with symptoms of fever with rash. Three serum samples were collected and sent to DPHL Lucknow. One sample came negative for Measles IgM by ELISA. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Chitisapur, Block Bhitaura, District Fatehpur. Cases presented with symptoms of loose motions vomiting with pain abdomen. House to house survey was conducted and treated symptomatically. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on food hygiene, safe drinking water and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Bairiya under Health facility Ramiya Behar District Kheri. Cases presented with symptoms of fever with rash. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey was conducted and treated symptomatically. Cases were in the age group 1 to 40 years. One person died due to septicemia. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Keshorghata, District Dinajpur Dakshin. Cases of the same family presented with symptoms of loose motions with pain abdomen. One water sample were collected and sent to WBPHL, Kolkata. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey was conducted and treated symptomatically. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on food hygiene, safe drinking water and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Baliyari, Sub District Mohanpur, District Gaya. Cases presented with fever with rash. 4 serum samples were collected and sent to testing. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases were of the age group of 2yrs to 6 yrs. One sample found positive for Measles IgM by ELISA. Vitamin A solution were given to the cases. House to house survey was done. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on importance of vaccination, hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Manguraha, Sub District Lauriya, District Paschim Champaran. Cases presented with fever with rash. 6 serum samples were collected and sent to testing.
